notes.subject: feat(agent): search past sessions across sibling git worktrees
notes.summary: search_workspace_sessions gains an opt-in include_worktrees flag that also searches saved sessions from sibling git worktrees, with origin labels and a read-only reader that never modifies those histories.

notes.subject: feat(sdk): give the CLI and Assistant read_file's context view
notes.summary: CLI and Assistant workspace-host sessions now use read_file with view "context" for first-pass file context, replacing the get_context tool, with Git status, hashes, dedupe, long-line paging, symbols, diagnostics and JSONC redaction.

1375d07f4d54533a1126115a8d58620ab0831636.summary: Question cards in the browser gateway now disappear once the question has been answered on another surface such as VS Code, instead of staying visible until the next question.

990ccb71cd3fb52137b5822494781f7a8480d128.summary: Yes/No choice card detection now uses only the turn's final message (summary or last text block) and ignores quoted question marks, avoiding bogus cards from mid-turn narration.

9d7bcacf33737f581333bd0a96854bf40ffbcb09.summary: When the agent finishes a turn waiting for the user and ends with a direct yes/no question, the chat now shows a Yes/No choice card; "A or B" questions are excluded.

364175354dab1b442032a2b0d736263d4c4cd4a4.summary: Reloading a session now restores the detected question card when the last turn ended waiting for the user, and dismissed cards stay dismissed when the same session is reloaded.opt.

23ff34dfa6f0822d84f54377058f097d6eba3881.summary: Fixes the Ask Agent question card unmounting and stealing focus from the answer field on every keystroke when using the browser gateway relay.

2b691a8919ec21e913d91c5669ca93827c7363ff.summary: Updates the backup witness container image to restic rest-server 0.14.0, pinned by digest, with no changes to flags, data layout or API.
